mapper.select: SELECT reservation_no, requirement_mat_code, actual_mat_code, SUM(requested_num) requested_num, SUM(issued_num) issued_num, SUM(received_num) received_num, SUM(line_stock_num) line_stock_num, SUM(fed_num) fed_num, SUM(used_num) used_num, SUM(pending_return_num) pending_return_num, SUM(approved_return_num) approved_return_num FROM (SELECT d.reservation_no, d.requirement_mat_code, d.mat_code actual_mat_code, d.mat_num requested_num, 0 issued_num, 0 received_num, 0 line_stock_num, 0 fed_num, 0 used_num, 0 pending_return_num, 0 approved_return_num FROM mes_warehouse_picking_bill_detail d JOIN mes_warehouse_picking_bill b ON b.id = d.bill_id AND b.del_flag = '0' WHERE d.del_flag = '0' AND d.reservation_no IS NOT NULL AND d.reservation_no != '' AND b.status IN ('1', '2', '3') UNION ALL SELECT reservation_no, requirement_mat_code, mat_code, 0, COALESCE (notice_in_num, 0), COALESCE (in_num, 0), 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM mes_warehouse_material_in_bill WHERE del_flag = '0' AND reservation_no IS NOT NULL AND reservation_no != '' UNION ALL SELECT reservation_no, requirement_mat_code, mat_code, 0, 0, 0, COALESCE (num, 0), 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM mes_warehouse_live_stock WHERE del_flag = '0' AND reservation_no IS NOT NULL AND reservation_no != '' UNION ALL SELECT reservation_no, requirement_mat_code, mat_code, 0, 0, 0, 0, COALESCE (feed_num, 0), COALESCE (used_num, 0), 0, 0 FROM mes_warehouse_feed WHERE del_flag = '0' AND reservation_no IS NOT NULL AND reservation_no != '' UNION ALL SELECT reservation_no, requirement_mat_code, mat_code, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, CASE WHEN status = '0' THEN COALESCE (num, 0) ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN status = '1' THEN COALESCE (num, 0) ELSE 0 END FROM mes_warehouse_stock_feed_judge WHERE del_flag = '0' AND reservation_no IS NOT NULL AND reservation_no != '' UNION ALL SELECT reservation_no, requirement_mat_code, mat_code, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, CASE WHEN status = '0' THEN COALESCE (num, 0) ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN status = '1' THEN COALESCE (num, 0) ELSE 0 END FROM mes_warehouse_feed_judge WHERE del_flag = '0' AND reservation_no IS NOT NULL AND reservation_no != '') evidence GROUP BY reservation_no, requirement_mat_code, actual_mat_code ORDER BY reservation_no, requirement_mat_code, actual_mat_code
